pages.text: $(bold)A Daily Roll$()$(br)Each morning every point has a $(bold)35%$() chance of trouble: forest fire, aphids, weeds, flood or drought. Only resolved incidents earn you points.

$(bold)Forest Fire$()$(br)Smouldering forestry flames break out nearby without spreading. Right-click with the $(bold)Fire Extinguisher$() to spray foam ahead of your crosshair and douse fires within $(bold)5 blocks$(); each use costs 1 durability.
$(bold)Aphid Infestation$()$(br)The trees are crawling with aphids. Right-click the affected tree with $(bold)Tree Paint$() to wipe them out.

$(bold)Overgrown Weeds$()$(br)Weeds run riot across the chunk. Right-click with $(bold)Herbicide$() to clear grass within $(bold)4 blocks$(); hit the overgrown point itself and the incident is resolved for points.

$(bold)Weather Instrument$()$(br)Set it in the point chunk: its vane turns lazily on a calm day, but spins furiously once unusual weather (fire, flood, drought, acid rain) strikes the chunk - the easiest early warning there is.
